about_the_game:
《100 Day Term》

——Countdown Begins! Write Your Reform Epic

▍Core Story: Absurdity vs Idealism

You, a youth with zero political experience
Become Chief Efficiency Officer of the United Spirit of Power (USP). In this absurd world where Congress is a "Stamp Club" and Defense Department is "Over-Budget Division", you have 100 days to:
✅ Eliminate fiscal black holes: Terminate projects like "Anti-gravity Chips R&D"
✅ Restore national sanity: Battle presidential "Greatness" metrics and bureaucratic sabotage

▍Revolutionary Mechanics

Power Balance System

  • 📊 Performance vs ✨ Greatness: Every choice impacts real reform vs vanity stats!

  • 👑 President Approval: Too low = fired. Blind obedience = puppet

  • 🏛️ Government Relation: Expose corruption → retaliation. Over-compromise → failure

120+ Event Chains

  • 《Air Tax》Storm: Support "Breathing Emission Tax"? Treasury↑ vs Rage↑

  • Patriotic Math Crisis: Legalize 2+2=5? Approval↑ vs Education↓

  • Alien Data Deal: Trade scandals for visa? Freedom↑ vs Dignity↓

Dual Storylines

  • 🛸 Cosmic Observation: Achieve "Cosmic Bureaucracy" ending

  • ⛰️ Swamp Ritual: Unlock "Great Eternal Swamp Saint" ending

▍Character Progression

  • Day 1: Sign "No Cursing Printers Pledge" in broken office

  • Day 30: Confront falsified Performance data - wear "Foam Medal" or resist

  • Day 100: Become hero/exiled scholar/system saint - your choices define you

▍Ultimate Challenges

  • ⏳ 100-Day Countdown: One critical decision per day

  • 📉 Data Distortion: Is rising Performance real when Greatness soars?

  • 🕵️ Rhetoric Decryption: Dissect traps like "Process Sanctity"

▍7 Endings

Glory? Disgrace? Escape Earth as cosmic citizen? Your fate awaits!

▍Developer's Note

*"A solo dev working nights and weekends since May 2025. As reality's absurdity outpaces my fiction at light speed, I tip my hat to certain... talents whose spectacle-making prowess dwarfs my humble game."*
